# Skyline by Candeur (also: Candeur Skyline, Skyline Candeur)

Website: https://skylinebycandeur.in

> Ultra-luxury residential project in Narsingi, Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Four 59-storey glass towers on 4.04 acres with one sky villa per floor. Developer: Candeur Constructions. TS RERA No. P02400005946. This website is run by an authorized channel partner and is for information only.

## Key facts
- Location: Narsingi, Hyderabad, Telangana 500089 — on the edge of the Financial District; near Gachibowli, Kokapet, Nanakramguda, Hitech City and the Narsingi ORR interchange
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/RrQgQAQjFaJF3UMH6
- Towers: 4 · Floors: 59 each · Land: 4.04 acres
- Residences per floor: 1 ("One floor. One sky villa.")
- Ceiling height: 13 ft
- Clubhouse: Club Atmos, 60,000 sq.ft.

## Residences
- Skydome — Tower A — 11,999 sq.ft. — East facing
- Skylight — Tower B — 7,495 sq.ft. — North facing
- Skycrest — Tower C — 7,495 sq.ft. — North facing
- Skylux — Tower D — 6,520 sq.ft. East facing / 6,600 sq.ft. North facing

## Amenities
Club Atmos clubhouse, rooftop pool lounge, fitness studio, games lounge, business centre, pergola promenade, amphitheatre lawn, kids' garden, play court, garden gazebo, landscaped gardens.
